Title: Honey Balsamic Roasted Carrots (KaleforniaKravings)

Items: 450 g carrots, washed and peeled (or unpeeled)

Instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Trim both ends off the carrots. Cut on the bias (diagonally) into thirds or roughly 4 cm pieces. If any pieces are very thick, cut them lengthwise so the pieces are a similar size.
In a large bowl, whisk together 15 ml oil, 15 ml balsamic vinegar, and 15 ml honey. Add the carrots, minced garlic, dried thyme, salt, and cracked black pepper. Toss until fully coated.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer the carrots to the prepared tray in an even layer. Reserve the liquid left in the bowl.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, or until tender. During the last 5–10 minutes, brush the reserved liquid over the carrots.
Mix the remaining 15 ml balsamic vinegar and 15 ml honey together, then drizzle over the roasted carrots. Toss to coat and adjust salt/pepper if needed.
Serve immediately, topped with crumbled goat cheese if using.
Customizations: Use olive oil instead of avocado oil.
Garnish with a few fresh thyme sprigs if you have them.
Swap goat cheese for feta if you prefer (it’ll be a bit saltier).
OptionalInstructions: Check the carrots around the 15 minute mark — oven times can vary.
For more colour, roast a few minutes longer, but keep an eye on the honey so it doesn’t burn.
ServingSuggestions: Serve as a side dish with roast chicken, pork, or a holiday meal.
Great served warm straight from the oven.
